# Learned Research Lessons

Agent-curated durable lessons from past research and reflection.

This file is **written by the Researcher**, not by the user. Human standing instructions belong in
`user_research_priorities.md`. Raw reflection output belongs in `logs/weekly_reflections.jsonl`;
only lessons that have proven durable graduate into this file.

## How to read this file

- **Weight recent lessons above old ones.** A lesson from last week outranks one from six months
  ago when the two conflict.
- **Check the market phase.** Each lesson records the phase it was learned in. A lesson learned in
  a different phase than today's market is a *hypothesis*, not a rule — apply it only if the
  current setup genuinely resembles the one that produced it.
- **Struck lessons are kept, not deleted.** A lesson contradicted by later evidence is marked
  `still valid?: no` with the contradicting evidence attached. It stays as a record of what was
  tried, so the same mistake is not re-learned.
- Do not treat this file as market fact. It records how *this system* has been wrong or right
  before, not what the market will do.

## How to append a lesson

One lesson per bullet, in this shape:

```markdown
- **YYYY/MM/DD** — [phase: <market phase when learned>] <the lesson, stated as a rule>
  - Evidence: <what produced it — prediction id, outcome id, or observation>
  - still valid?: yes | no | unclear <+ reason if no/unclear>
```

Market phase values: `bull`, `bear`, `consolidation/震荡`, `policy-driven`, `liquidity-driven`,
`theme-driven`, `unclear`.

Rules:

- One lesson per bullet. Do not bundle several observations into one.
- State it as an actionable rule, not a summary of what happened.
- A one-off observation is not a lesson. It needs to have recurred, or to have cost something.
- Append at the end of the Lessons section. Never rewrite this header.
